faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about {{appName}}.
faq.a1: Yes, for users, booking is 100% free. You simply pay for your meal at the restaurant.
faq.q2: How do I cancel my booking?
faq.a2: You can cancel or modify your booking at any time from your account or via the link received by SMS/Email.
faq.q3: Do I need to create an account?
faq.a3: No, you can book as a guest. However, creating an account allows you to manage your bookings more easily.
faq.q4: How do I know if my booking is confirmed?
faq.a4: You receive an immediate confirmation by email and SMS as soon as you validate your booking.

hero.headline: Manage your reservations and dining room
hero.description: Software designed for independent restaurant owners who want to focus on their craft, not on complex tools.

value_proposition.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
value_proposition.subtitle: Essential features designed for independent restaurant owners' daily operations.
value_proposition.benefit_1_desc: Receive and manage your reservations instantly, from any device.
value_proposition.benefit_2_desc: Visualize your dining room at a glance and manage seating easily.
value_proposition.benefit_3_desc: Find your customers' history and preferences in just a few clicks.
value_proposition.benefit_4_desc: No training required. Intuitive interface designed for the field.

product_overview.title: A tool built for service
product_overview.subtitle: Clear screens and quick actions to manage your restaurant efficiently.
product_overview.reservations_desc: Manage all your reservations from a single interface. Automatic confirmations, customer reminders, and calendar view to anticipate your services.
product_overview.floor_plan_desc: View your table occupancy in real-time. Drag and drop to reorganize, see available tables at a glance.
product_overview.clients_desc: Centralize your regular customers' information. Notes, preferences, allergies - everything is accessible in one click when taking a reservation.

pricing.title: A plan for every restaurant
pricing.subtitle: Simple and transparent pricing, no surprises. Choose the plan that fits your needs.

reassurance.title: A trusted partner
reassurance.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your data and providing you with a reliable daily tool.
reassurance.item_1_desc: Developed in collaboration with field professionals to meet their real needs.
reassurance.item_2_desc: Your data and your customers' data are processed in full compliance with European regulations.
reassurance.item_3_desc: Hosted in France, daily backups, and end-to-end encryption.
reassurance.item_4_desc: A tool adapted to your reality, without unnecessary features or superfluous complexity.

testimonials.title: What our customers say
testimonials.subtitle: Hundreds of restaurateurs trust us every day
testimonials.testimonial_1_text: Since I started using {{appName}}, I've saved precious time every day. The interface is intuitive and my customers appreciate the automatic reminders.
testimonials.testimonial_2_text: Finally a tool designed for small restaurants! No more reservation notebooks and mistakes. {{appName}} has transformed our organization.
testimonials.testimonial_3_text: The interactive floor plan is amazing. I can see at a glance which tables are free and reorganize easily.
testimonials.testimonial_4_text: The value for money is unbeatable. For €39 a month, I have access to all the features I need.

footer.slogan: Service management, simplified. A tool designed for independent restaurant owners.
footer.made_with_love: Made with care for independent restaurateurs 🇫🇷
